name: Workbench
description: The project schematic: one OpenPara project file (.opara) that holds parts, assemblies, analyses and the other tools as blocks on a canvas, with wires between their cells (the geometry of a part feeding the geometry of an analysis) and a status mark on every cell (up to date, incomplete, refresh needed, update needed, failed). Blocks lock to a grid, a box selects several, a selection moves as one and the wires follow. Opens at the start in the Playground's Full dev mode. Under development: it comes with a LOAD EXAMPLE PROJECT button and a PROJECT REPORT. Results are not saved in the project: opening one never starts a computation, the cells say update needed until you press Update.
